resources.string: Navigate a steadier sky with adjustable fluidity; Balanced is the default.
Create Android alarms or calendar events for future orbital points from the sky or daily path.
Explore Tesla Roadster (2018), with heliocentric ephemerides, reference data and a downloadable image.
Recognize current and key events more easily in the daily path, with a highlighted current row and bold key-event values.
Remove an object directly from its main card with confirmation, and recognize its name by the orbit color.
Point callouts stay above celestial icons without jumping; object names and photo/panorama legends keep the full object color.
